title: Homogeneous polynomial evaluations lift uniquely into ideal-power sheaves
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, $X$ a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ a morphism, and $x:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to A$ a finite family generating $I$, allowing $r=0$. Let $J=I\mathcal O_X$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal], and let $J^k$ with inclusion $\iota_k:J^k\to\mathcal O_X$ be the actual recursively constructed power module [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk]. For an open $U$ let $\rho_U:A\to\mathcal O_X(U)$ be $f^\sharp$ followed by restriction. There exist functions $l_{k,U}:A[T_0,\ldots,T_{r-1}]_k\to J^k(U)$, where the domain consists of polynomials homogeneous of degree $k$, such that $\iota_k(l_{k,U}(b))=b(\rho_U(x_0),\ldots,\rho_U(x_{r-1}))$, with coefficients evaluated by $\rho_U$. The formula includes $k=0$ and every open, even the empty open. The image formula determines every lift uniquely because the inclusions are monic.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, proof of Lemma 0884 (lemma-vanishing-projective), first paragraph; finite polynomial cover refinement of the associated graded ideal algebra. Supporting affine calculations: Schemes 01I8 and 01IC, as recorded by lem-weil-pbc-ideal-times-quasi-coherent-affine-sections.

proof.text: Prove formalPolynomial_power_mono for any monic map from an arbitrary module into the structure module, by two-step induction on the recursive power: degree zero is identity, degree one is the given mono, and higher inclusions are composites of image inclusions and the preceding mono. The forgetful functor preserves monos, so formalPolynomial_power_injective gives sectionwise injectivity. Specialize these shared public lemmas to J.toModulesι. formalPolynomial_extendedIdeal_affine supplies the shared affine generator calculation.

On an affine open V, apply ideal_comap_appLE at the top affine open of Spec A. ideal_top_ofIdealTop and Ideal.map_span identify J(V) with the span of the images of x_i under rho_V. For b homogeneous of degree k, its coefficient-map image remains homogeneous by MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous.map. Ideal.mem_span_pow_iff_exists_isHomogeneous shows that its evaluation is in J(V)^k. If k>0 the affine power-range clause of ideal_times_quasiCoherent_affine_sections lifts it. If k=0 use the identity power inclusion.

For an arbitrary open U use all affine subopens V contained in U as a cover. Choose the uniquely determined affine preimages. Polynomial evaluation commutes with restriction, by MvPolynomial.map_eval₂Hom and composition of the structure sheaf restriction maps. On each pairwise intersection, naturality of the power inclusion and sectionwise injectivity identify the two restrictions, without assuming the intersection affine. TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing' glues them. TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' for the structure sheaf verifies the required image formula globally. Choose the resulting uniquely determined lifts for all k,U,b.

proof_origin.place: Complete Lean proof of the affine power refinement of Stacks Tags 0884 and 087Z, using Schemes Tags 01I8 and 01IC; elementary gluing and monomial details written by G2.

lean.statement:
theorem formalPolynomial_power_lifts
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
    {r : ℕ} (generators : Fin r → A)
    (hgenerators : Ideal.span (Set.range generators) = I)
 :
    ∃ l : ∀ (k : ℕ) (U : X.Opens),
      MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin r) A k →
        (Scheme.idealSheafPower ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
        (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f).toModulesι k).1.val.obj
          (op U),
      (∀ k U b, (Scheme.idealSheafPower _ k).2.val.app (op U) (l k U b) =
        MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom
          (((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top (a := U))).op).hom).comp
            (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom))
          (fun i => (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top (a := U))).op).hom
            (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom (generators i))) b.val)
